tokenizer.description: returns a token length and writes a token type to an out-parameter; can return an illegal-token sentinel for corrupt input

dequote_helper.description: helper that copies token text and dequotes it, assuming the token is syntactically valid

illegal_token_sentinel.description: token type value indicating the tokenizer encountered illegal/corrupt input

dequoter_with_precondition.description: dequoter that has a precondition/assertion for valid quoted tokens

caller_ignoring_sentinel.description: caller that ignores the tokenizer's illegal-token sentinel before invoking the dequote helper
